messages:
Ali: Heads-up 0: GreenGrove Health sent a 40-ish question security pack (mix of vendor Qs + CAIQ snippets). They asked for SOC2 evidence, KMS/BYOK details, EU data residency confirmation, and a staging contact for the POC. Need an owner + ETA. PDF: https://files.gdrive/greengrove-pack.pdf

Jordan: I can own the POC infra bits and staging access. @Maria can you own the control answers and SOC2 artifacts?

Maria: I can do the control responses. Quick Qs: is the POC going to be Hosted or Dedicated? BYOK support differs. Also do we have a recent SOC2 snapshot in the repo?

Ali: Customer prefers BYOK, explicitly asked whether prompts/inputs are persisted and for how long. Also wants a single contact for follow-up. I'll be the named contact unless someone else volunteers.

Sam: Legal wants a DPIA note if any PHI is involved. Ali, did they say PHI?

Ali: They said the POC will include de-identified patient summaries for testing, but could escalate to PHI later.

sec-bot: Intake created: ticket VG-2026-219. Status: open. Owner: unassigned.

Maria: Short answers we can provide now: - Logs/inputs retention: default 30 days (configurable). - Hosted: no customer-managed KMS; Dedicated/Private: BYOK via KMS/HSM integrations. - EU residency: we have EU-region hosting for Dedicated and VPC Private deployments. Need legal to confirm data processing addendum for PHI.

Jordan: For POC we can spin a Dedicated trial (1x A10G) 04-48h provisioning after approval. We support OIDC/SAML for staging SSO. Example for Okta:

```yaml
sso:
  provider: okta
  type: oidc
  redirect_uri: https://staging.greengrove.health/callback
```

Infra: can you confirm partner-managed KMS paths (Azure Key Vault, AWS KMS) for Dedicated?

Infra (Eng-Infra): Confirmed: Dedicated and Private support customer KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP CMEK) and HSM-backed options. Partner-managed key wrapping can be configured; I'll send the integration checklist. Expect 1-2 days to validate for the account.

Maria: Good. SOC2 artifacts 021 snapshot available. I will collate SOC2 summary + control mappings into VG-2026-219 in ~3 business days. If they require a full CAIQ matrix for Hosted, plan for 10+ business days. Flagging timeline risk.

Sam: Added ticket to deal checklist and set a 4-day follow-up reminder. Pricing note: sales ops is provisional on waiving Dedicated trial fees for POC.

Ali: I'll email GreenGrove now: named contact Ali, aiming for draft answers in 3-4 business days, will confirm BYOK path after infra verifies.

Maria: Action items: 1) Ill draft control answers + attach SOC2 summary (3 business days). 2) Infra to confirm BYOK integration details (1-2 days). 3) Legal to check DPIA/PHI clauses (Sam to spin up legal ticket).

sec-bot: Ticket VG-2026-219 updated: owner set to Maria, Jordan. Status: in_progress.

Jordan: If customer accepts Dedicated for POC we can keep timeline tight. If they insist on Hosted CAIQ mapping, push to later and set expectations.

Ali: Will get Hosting preference by EOD and post back. Thanks all :thumbsup:
